rubric.role_summary: Director-level clinical pharmacology role supporting drug discovery and development programmes. Leads quantitative clinical pharmacology and model-informed drug development across nonclinical and clinical stages, including translation of PK/PD data, trial design and dose selection.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Director-level clinical pharmacology role supporting drug discovery and development programmes. Leads quantitative clinical pharmacology and model-informed drug development across nonclinical and clinical stages, including translation of PK/PD data, trial design and dose selection.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- A PhD, PharmD or MD specialised in DMPK, Pharmacometrics, in vivo/Clinical Pharmacology or a related scientific discipline, OR equivalent industry experience in a lead Quantitative Clinical Pharmacology position.
- Significant pharmaceutical or biotech industry experience in Quantitative Clinical Pharmacology.
- Experience applying quantitative pharmacometric modelling.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience across therapeutic modalities, including small molecules, biologics and novel platforms.
- Significant pharmaceutical or biotech industry experience in Quantitative Clinical Pharmacology spanning all stages of development, with understanding of drug discovery and non-clinical and clinical development and a proven MIDD track record.
- A foundation in in vivo and clinical pharmacology and quantitative drug development, with experience applying advanced quantitative modelling and proficiency in core pharmacometric software, alongside data analytics and emerging AI-enabled approaches. The named software packages are examples, not a requirement to know all of them.
- Understanding of the regulatory landscape and how to integrate nonclinical, translational and clinical data for development.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Greater London area. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.

You will have a strong understanding of drug discovery, non-clinical and clinical development with a proven track record of applying Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) principles.
